description: This PHP source file defines the 'FieldDiscovery' class within the Drupal migrate_drupal module. It provides functionality for discovering and managing field plugins and source data related to Drupal 6 and 7 migrations, including methods for retrieving field information, managing plugins, and handling migration core version detection.

classes.name: FieldDiscovery
classes.description: Provides methods for discovering and managing fields and plugins for Drupal 6 & 7 migrations within the migrate_drupal module.

methods.name: addAllFieldProcesses
methods.description: Adds processing pipelines for all fields in the migration.

methods.name: addEntityFieldProcesses
methods.description: Adds processing pipelines for all fields of a specific entity type.

methods.name: addBundleFieldProcesses
methods.description: Adds processing pipelines for all fields within a specific bundle of an entity type.

methods.name: getFieldPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate field plugin for a given field type and migration.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Retrieves all field information related to the migration, cached per core version.

methods.name: getEntityFields
methods.description: Retrieves field information for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getBundleFields
methods.description: Retrieves field information for a specific bundle within an entity type.

methods.name: getSourcePlugin
methods.description: Gets the source plugin used to gather field information, based on core version.

methods.name: getFieldInstanceStubMigrationDefinition
methods.description: Provides a stub migration definition for a specific Drupal core version.

methods.name: getCoreVersion
methods.description: Determines the Drupal core version for a given migration based on tags.
